entries.en: Only the acetyliodide from the first trial was available for the follow-up analysis.
entries.zh: 后续分析时，只有第一次试验的乙酰碘可供使用。

entries.en: The analyst compared the acetylisoeugenol spectrum with two reference spectra before drawing a conclusion.
entries.zh: 分析员将乙酰异丁子香酚的谱图与两张参比谱图进行比较后，才得出了结论。

entries.en: The experiment was repeated because acetylization had not progressed as far as expected.
entries.zh: 由于乙酰化作用没有达到预期程度，实验重新做了一次。

entries.en: The acetylizer remained idle while the maintenance crew inspected its control panel.
entries.zh: 维修人员检查控制面板期间，乙酰化器一直处于停机状态。

entries.en: The sealed acetylmethadol reference sample arrived a day later than the accompanying documents.
entries.zh: 密封的醋美沙醇对照样品比随附文件晚到一天。

entries.en: The laboratory requested a reference sample before identifying the acetylmorphine in the seized material.
entries.zh: 实验室在确定查获材料中乙酰吗啡的身份之前，要求提供一份对照样品。

entries.en: We kept the acetylnaphthylamine results separate until the isomer had been identified.
entries.zh: 在确定异构体之前，我们将乙酰萘胺的结果单独保留。

entries.en: We did not assume the two acetylphenol samples were identical merely because their masses matched.
entries.zh: 我们没有仅因两份乙酰苯酚样品质量相同，就认定它们完全相同。

entries.en: The proposed explanation did not account for all the acetylphenylhydrazine detected in the recovered material.
entries.zh: 所提出的解释无法说明回收材料中检出的全部乙酰苯肼。

entries.en: The acetylpyrazine peak was still visible after the baseline had been corrected.
entries.zh: 基线校正后，乙酰吡嗪的峰仍然可见。

entries.en: The mixture contained more than one acetylpyridine isomer, which complicated the comparison.
entries.zh: 混合物中含有不止一种乙酰吡啶异构体，这增加了比较的难度。

entries.en: A damaged outer carton delayed the acceptance of the acetylsulfafurazole shipment.
entries.zh: 外纸箱受损，延误了这批醋磺胺异恶唑的验收。

entries.en: The second analysis found acetylsulfamethoxazole in a sample that had initially been set aside.
entries.zh: 第二次分析在最初被搁置的一份样品中检出了醋磺胺甲恶唑。

entries.en: Without the missing calibration data, we could not compare the acetylsulfanilamide concentrations reliably.
entries.zh: 缺少那些校准数据，我们就无法可靠地比较乙酰氨苯磺胺的浓度。

entries.en: An error in the recorded mass changed the calculated amount of acetylthiohydantoin recovered.
entries.zh: 记录的质量有误，导致计算出的1-乙酰基乙内酰硫脲回收量发生了变化。

entries.en: The chemist declined to identify the acetylthymol sample from that blurred spectrum alone.
entries.zh: 那位化学家不愿仅凭那张模糊的谱图就确定乙酰百里香酚样品的身份。

entries.en: The acetyltoluene measurements were grouped by isomer rather than averaged together.
entries.zh: 乙酰甲苯的测量结果按异构体分组，而没有放在一起取平均值。

entries.en: We found less acetylurea in the final fraction than the initial calculation had predicted.
entries.zh: 我们在最终馏分中发现的乙酰脲，少于最初计算所预测的量。

entries.meaningZh: 幺二〔十五子棋的一种玩法〕
entries.en: We played acey-deucey beside the window until it was time to board the ferry.
entries.zh: 我们在窗边玩幺二，一直玩到该登上渡轮的时候。

entries.meaningZh: 幺二〔十五子棋的一种玩法〕
entries.en: Nora put away the acey-deucy board when the guests arrived for dinner.
entries.zh: 客人来吃晚饭时，诺拉收起了幺二棋盘。

entries.en: Acha offered me the window seat because I wanted to sketch the harbour.
entries.zh: 我想画海港的速写，阿查便把靠窗的座位让给了我。

entries.en: In the school play, Achan paused at the doorway before answering the messenger.
entries.zh: 在学校的话剧里，亚干先在门口停顿了一下，然后才回答信使。

entries.en: She attacked the final movement with an acharnement that left the audience breathless.
entries.zh: 她以一股猛烈的劲头奏起最后一个乐章，令观众屏息凝神。

entries.en: Acharya brought a spare notebook in case anyone forgot to bring one to the workshop.
entries.zh: 阿查里雅多带了一本笔记本，以防有人来工作坊时忘记携带。

entries.en: After the rain, a patch of acheb appeared on the slope beside our camp.
entries.zh: 雨后，我们营地旁的山坡上出现了一片短暂型植被。

entries.en: Achenbach asked the audience to keep the aisle clear while the choir entered.
entries.zh: 合唱团入场时，阿亨巴赫请观众保持过道畅通。

entries.en: Achenbaum lent us a trolley to move the heavy boxes into the gallery.
entries.zh: 阿肯鲍姆借给我们一辆小推车，把沉重的箱子运进画廊。

entries.en: The botanist turned the achenocarp under the magnifier to inspect its damaged surface.
entries.zh: 植物学家在放大镜下转动那枚不裂干果，检查受损的表面。

entries.en: One achenodium had fallen out of the packet before we examined the fruits.
entries.zh: 我们检查果实之前，一枚双瘦果已经从小袋中掉了出来。

entries.en: Acher kept a place in the queue while I fetched our forgotten tickets.
entries.zh: 我去取忘带的票时，阿切尔帮忙在队伍里占着位置。

entries.en: A thin cloud hid Achernar just as I adjusted the telescope for another look.
entries.zh: 就在我调整望远镜准备再看一次时，一片薄云遮住了水委一。

entries.en: Achi found a dry bench where we could spread out the wet maps.
entries.zh: 阿希找到了一张干燥的长凳，让我们可以把湿地图摊开。

entries.en: The designer sent Achieva three sketches and asked which layout the team preferred.
entries.zh: 设计师向益启发发送了三张草图，询问团队更喜欢哪种布局。

entries.en: The old collection contained achilletin that had never been included in the digital inventory.
entries.zh: 那批旧藏品中有一份从未录入电子库存清单的蓍草素。

entries.en: He was anxious about the achillobursitis, not about the old scar on his hand.
entries.zh: 让他担心的是跟腱黏液囊炎，而不是手上的旧伤疤。

entries.en: Persistent achillodynia made her anxious about the walk she had planned with her friends.
entries.zh: 持续的跟腱痛让她担心起原计划与朋友们一起进行的徒步活动。

entries.en: He asked for more time to consider the proposed achillotenotomy before signing anything.
entries.zh: 在签署任何文件之前，他要求多一点时间考虑所提议的跟腱切断术。

entries.en: There was a dull achiness in my shoulders when I woke.
entries.zh: 我醒来时，肩膀隐隐酸痛。

entries.en: Her achiria was unrelated to the reason she had come to the clinic that morning.
entries.zh: 她当天上午来诊所的原因与她的无手畸形无关。

entries.meaningZh: 爱客坎〔南亚男式长上衣〕
entries.en: The tailor shortened the sleeves of my achkan before the evening reception.
entries.zh: 晚间招待会之前，裁缝把我的爱客坎长上衣的袖子改短了。

entries.en: Achmad carried the empty trays back to the kitchen after the guests had left.
entries.zh: 客人离开后，艾哈迈德把空托盘端回了厨房。

entries.en: Achmed volunteered to collect the keys while the rest of us loaded the van.
entries.zh: 我们其他人装货上车时，艾哈迈德主动提出去取钥匙。

entries.en: An Acholi in our workshop offered to translate the invitation for the visiting artists.
entries.zh: 工作坊里的一位阿乔利人主动提出为来访艺术家翻译邀请函。

entries.en: The faint outline of an achroacyte was still visible near the edge of the photograph.
entries.zh: 照片边缘附近仍可看到一个淋巴细胞淡淡的轮廓。

entries.en: The unexplained achroacytosis prompted a careful review of the earlier laboratory records.
entries.zh: 原因不明的淋巴细胞增多促使他们仔细复查先前的化验记录。

entries.en: The analysts disagreed about the amount of achrodextrin in the recovered material.
entries.zh: 分析员们对回收材料中的消色糊精含量存在分歧。

entries.en: The enlarged image showed an achromacyte beside several darker cells.
entries.zh: 放大图像中，一个无色红细胞旁边有几个颜色较深的细胞。

entries.en: An achromate in our workshop asked us to number the coloured parts before the next session.
entries.zh: 工作坊里的一位色盲参与者请我们在下次活动前给彩色零件编号。

entries.en: The lens redesign improved achromatization without increasing the length of the housing.
entries.zh: 重新设计透镜改善了消色效果，却没有增加外壳的长度。

entries.en: Unexpected achromatophilia prevented a clear comparison between the two stained sections.
entries.zh: 意料之外的拒染性使两张染色切片难以清楚地进行比较。

entries.en: Because of his achromatopsy, the colour-coded chart was of little use to him.
entries.zh: 由于完全色盲，那张用颜色编码的图表对他用处不大。

entries.en: We compared two achromats before choosing the lens for the demonstration.
entries.zh: 选定演示用透镜之前，我们比较了两枚消色差透镜。

entries.en: The nurse asked when he had first noticed the achromaturia.
entries.zh: 护士询问他最早何时注意到尿液无色。

entries.en: Her achromotrichia was already noticeable in the photograph taken several years earlier.
entries.zh: 数年前拍摄的那张照片中，她的毛发褪色已经很明显。

entries.en: Achter covered the table with a clean cloth before we unpacked the fragile models.
entries.zh: 我们拆开那些易碎模型的包装前，阿赫特用干净的布盖好了桌子。

entries.en: The pharmacist compared the batch numbers on two unopened boxes of aciclovir.
entries.zh: 药剂师比较了两盒未开封阿昔洛维的批号。

entries.en: When the slide shifted, several aciculae moved out of the camera's field.
entries.zh: 载玻片一动，几颗针状结晶就移出了相机视野。

entries.en: The zoologist enlarged the photograph to examine the damaged aciculum.
entries.zh: 动物学家放大照片，查看受损的足刺。

entries.en: The clinician was concerned about the acidaemia but had not yet established its cause.
entries.zh: 那位临床医生对酸血症感到担忧，但尚未查明其原因。

entries.en: We tested the same acidifier in both batches to keep that part of the comparison consistent.
entries.zh: 我们在两个批次中试用了相同的成酸剂，以使这一部分的比较保持一致。

entries.en: Acidization was postponed until the damaged pipe had been replaced.
entries.zh: 酸化作业被推迟了，直到损坏的管道更换完毕才进行。

entries.en: She could hear the acidness in his voice even though his words were polite.
entries.zh: 尽管他措辞客气，她还是听出了他声音里的尖刻。

entries.en: The acidolin results could not be reproduced when a second analyst checked the same material.
entries.zh: 另一名分析员检查同一份材料时，未能重复得出先前的嗜酸乳菌素结果。

entries.en: Unexpected acidolysis complicated the interpretation of the experiment.
entries.zh: 意外发生的酸解作用使实验结果更难解读。

entries.en: The laboratory could not complete the comparison without a fresh acidomycin reference sample.
entries.zh: 没有新的酸霉素对照样品，实验室就无法完成比较。

entries.en: The manufacturer changed the acidulant but kept the rest of the formula unchanged.
entries.zh: 生产商更换了酸化剂，但配方的其余部分保持不变。

entries.en: The delay occurred before acidulation, not during the later drying stage.
entries.zh: 延误发生在酸化之前，而不是后续的干燥阶段。

entries.en: The printer postponed acierage until the damaged plate could be examined.
entries.zh: 印刷工人推迟了电镀铁处理，等待检查那块受损的印版。

entries.en: Acierno offered us shelter in the studio when the rain began.
entries.zh: 开始下雨时，阿切尔诺让我们到画室里避雨。

entries.en: Aciman set aside the broken frame and helped me carry the painting indoors.
entries.zh: 阿西曼把破损的画框放到一边，帮我将画搬进室内。

entries.en: The acipimox reference sample was missing from the delivery, although the invoice included it.
entries.zh: 这批交货中缺少阿西莫司对照样品，发票上却列有这一项。

entries.en: Ackerley stayed after the concert to help return the borrowed chairs.
entries.zh: 音乐会结束后，阿克利留下来帮忙归还借来的椅子。

entries.en: Acklin brought a blanket for anyone who wanted to sit on the grass.
entries.zh: 阿克林带来了一条毯子，供想坐在草地上的人使用。

entries.en: Ackoff noticed the loose wheel before we loaded the trolley with books.
entries.zh: 我们把书装上小推车之前，阿科夫就发现了松动的轮子。

entries.en: The laboratory returned the aclantate sample because the container's seal had been damaged in transit.
entries.zh: 由于容器封口在运输中受损，实验室退回了那份阿克兰酯样品。

entries.meaningZh: 阿克梅派〔俄国诗歌流派〕
entries.en: He preferred the poems associated with Acmeism to the abstract verse we had read earlier.
entries.zh: 与我们先前读过的抽象诗作相比，他更喜欢与阿克梅派相关的诗歌。

entries.en: During the examination, he was asked to compare acmesthesia on the two sides of his body.
entries.zh: 检查时，他被要求比较身体两侧的针刺感觉。

entries.en: An acmite specimen from the teaching collection had been packed in the wrong box.
entries.zh: 教学藏品中的一块锥辉石标本被装进了错误的盒子。

entries.en: At higher resolution, the plot revealed an acnode that the earlier image had missed.
entries.zh: 分辨率提高后，图中显出了先前图像未显示的一个孤点。

entries.en: Acocella held the ladder steady while I straightened the banner above the stage.
entries.zh: 我扶正舞台上方的横幅时，阿科切拉稳稳地扶着梯子。

entries.en: We sent our friends in Acoma a photograph of the finished quilt.
entries.zh: 我们给在阿科马的朋友寄去了一张做好的拼布被的照片。

entries.en: Several acontia had been damaged before the specimen reached the laboratory.
entries.zh: 标本送到实验室前，几条枪丝已经受损。

entries.en: Neither instrument detected acoradiene in the control, although both found it in the test sample.
entries.zh: 两台仪器都未在对照中检出菖蒲二烯，却都在试验样品中检出了它。

entries.en: The proposed mechanism did not account for the acorane recovered at the end of the experiment.
entries.zh: 所提出的机理无法解释实验结束时回收到的菖蒲烷。

entries.en: The acorenone measurements were discarded after we discovered the calibration error.
entries.zh: 发现校准错误后，我们弃用了菖蒲烯酮的测量结果。

entries.en: A second instrument was needed to confirm the unexpected acorone result.
entries.zh: 需要用第二台仪器来确认那个意外的菖蒲酮结果。

entries.en: Her defence of acosmism failed to persuade the other members of the philosophy group.
entries.zh: 她为无宇宙论所作的辩护未能说服哲学小组的其他成员。

entries.en: An acosmist joined the debate but objected to the way the question had been framed.
entries.zh: 一位无宇宙论者加入了辩论，却反对问题的表述方式。

entries.en: Acosta put the kettle on while we searched the cupboards for matching cups.
entries.zh: 我们在橱柜里寻找配套杯子时，阿科斯塔烧上了水。

entries.en: For the demonstration, she chose an acotyledon from the teaching collection.
entries.zh: 为作演示，她从教学藏品中选了一株无子叶植物。

entries.en: The acouchy emerged from behind the log just as I put my camera away.
entries.zh: 就在我收起相机时，那只长尾刺鼠从木头后面钻了出来。

entries.en: The technician found a loose connection inside the acoustimeter during the inspection.
entries.zh: 技术员在检查时发现测音计内部有一处连接松动。

entries.en: Her project in acoustoelectronics required close cooperation between the two laboratories.
entries.zh: 她的微声电子学项目需要两个实验室密切合作。

entries.en: The acoustometer was taken out of service after its readings became erratic.
entries.zh: 那台检响计的读数变得不稳定后，就停用了。

entries.en: The acoustooptics project brought together researchers who had previously worked in separate departments.
entries.zh: 声光学项目把此前在不同院系工作的研究人员聚到了一起。

entries.en: Acquaviva left a basket of clean towels outside the room we were using.
entries.zh: 阿夸维瓦把一篮干净毛巾放在了我们使用的房间外面。

entries.en: The committee weighed both the cost and the acquirability of the missing materials.
entries.zh: 委员会既考虑了所缺材料的成本，也考虑了它们的可获得性。

entries.meaningZh: 被收购方〔主要美式商业用语〕
entries.en: The acquiree kept its old name for several months after the deal.
entries.zh: 被收购方在交易完成后，保留原名称达数月之久。

entries.en: An eager acquisitor, she added every drawing at the studio sale to her collection.
entries.zh: 她热衷购藏，把画室售卖活动中的每幅画都收入了自己的收藏。

entries.en: News of his acquitment reached the village before he returned from the court.
entries.zh: 他尚未从法庭回来，无罪获释的消息就已传到了村里。

entries.en: Only the acra were visible beneath the blanket in the anatomical sketch.
entries.zh: 在那张解剖草图中，毯子下面只露出了肢端。

entries.en: His acrasia was plain: despite deciding to save money, he ordered another expensive gadget.
entries.zh: 他的自控能力缺失显而易见：尽管决定存钱，他还是又订购了一件昂贵的小玩意儿。

entries.en: Her final estimate of acrasin concentration was much lower than the initial estimate.
entries.zh: 她最终估计的聚集素浓度远低于最初的估计值。

entries.meaningZh: 英亩-英尺〔体积单位，复数〕
entries.en: The revised estimate expressed the reservoir's water loss in acre-feet rather than litres.
entries.zh: 修正后的估计用英亩-英尺而不是升来表示水库的失水量。

entries.en: An additional acre-inch of water was included in the revised irrigation estimate.
entries.zh: 修正后的灌溉估算中，额外计入了一英亩-英寸的水量。

entries.en: The damaged gate let almost an acrefoot of water escape before we noticed.
entries.zh: 损坏的闸门使将近一英亩-英尺的水流失了，我们才发现。

entries.en: The tank held less than an acreinch of water when the inspection began.
entries.zh: 开始检查时，水箱里的水量还不到一英亩-英寸。

entries.en: The revised structure includes an acridanyl group that was absent from the first drawing.
entries.zh: 修订后的结构中有一个二氢化吖啶基，最初的图中没有画出。

entries.en: She chose acridology after a summer counting insects in the grassland.
entries.zh: 在草原上度过一个清点昆虫的夏天后，她选择了研究蝗虫学。

entries.en: The final analysis accounted for the acridone that had been missing from the preliminary calculation.
entries.zh: 最终分析计入了初步计算中漏掉的吖啶酮。

entries.en: The chemist moved the acridyl group to a different position in the proposed structure.
entries.zh: 化学家在所提议的结构中，将吖啶基移到了另一个位置。

entries.en: The student outlined a single acritarch in the enlarged photograph of the sample.
entries.zh: 学生在样品的放大照片上描出了一枚疑源类微体化石的轮廓。

entries.en: The pilot's acrobacy drew loud applause from the spectators along the fence.
entries.zh: 飞行员的高难度飞行特技赢得了围栏旁观众的热烈掌声。

entries.en: The film's acrobatism impressed me more than its thin storyline.
entries.zh: 与影片单薄的故事情节相比，其中的杂技更令我印象深刻。
